title: Rav Nachman bar Rav Zavda
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In Shabbat 25b, Abaye said to Rava: “Rav Nachman bar Rav Zavda—and some say Rav Nachman bar Rava—said in Rav’s name.” Dikdukei Soferim reads Rav Chanin bar Rav Chisda.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The Nachman bar Zavda, Nachman bar Rava and Chanin bar Rav Chisda forms are alternative readings, not newly merged identities.

Shabbat 25b writes Rav Nachman bar Rav Zavda and gives Rav Nachman bar Rava as an alternative transmitter of Rav. In its dialogue, Abaye objects to Rava and Rava replies with the teaching. Hyman’s abbreviated report is retained; the heading’s explicit Rav before Zavda is distinguished from the body’s בר׳. The reported Dikdukei Soferim reading Rav Chanin bar Rav Chisda has not been independently collated.
